[SWS_CanTSyn_00170]
Upstream requirements: RS_TS_20073
⌈If CanTSynIcvGenerationBase for the Time Domain is configured to ICV_SIG-
NATURE, the Time Master shall call Csm_SignatureGenerate to generate the ICV
value.⌋
Note: The mode parameter is intentionally left open for the implementer to choose (
i.e. CRYPTO_OPERATIONMODE_SINGLECALL would possibly be the best option since
it does not require further calls to CSM).
The CSM job used to generate the ICV can be configured to synchronous or asyn-
chronous behaviour.
